name: Bluspring Enterprises Ltd
tagline: Integrated facilities-management / business-services rollup demerged from Quess Corp - revenue grows but razor-thin margins, negative ROE and a ~126x multiple rule out the screen thesis
business_overview: Bluspring (listed June 2025 on demerger from Quess Corp) bundles security, housekeeping, canteen, and facility maintenance services, plus operating-asset management, into an integrated 'facilities and asset management' offering. It was built inside Quess over ~Rs 900 Cr of acquisitions/investment. Addressable market is cited at ~Rs 1.7 lakh Cr, largely unorganised. The STEAG acquisition adds thermal-power O&M, a segment management says carries roughly 2x Bluspring's current margins.
fundamentals_table: Rs 2,969 Cr, +15% YoY; FY26 target >Rs 3,400 Cr (20%+ growth)
Low single digit; management targets only ~6% by 2030
Borrowings ~Rs 136 Cr (Sep-2025); targeting debt-free in 2-3 years
fundamentals_narrative: This is a labour-arbitrage services rollup: revenue scales with contract wins but margins are structurally thin (a ~6% EBITDA target a full five years out implies ~3-4% today) and the business is currently around breakeven on net profit, so ROE is negative. At ~126x earnings the market is already paying up for the demerger-optionality and STEAG accretion. No red flag in the strict sense (low debt, going-concern intact, transition-year losses), but the economics do not support a multi-bagger thesis.
technical_read: Not pulled - not a Tier-A candidate.

bull_case: Large, mostly unorganised TAM (~Rs 1.7 lakh Cr) with formalisation tailwind; 15-20% revenue growth achievable
STEAG adds a higher-margin (~2x segment) O&M line and cross-sell into thermal capacity
Low debt, stated path to debt-free in 2-3 years
Integrated single-vendor pitch (security + housekeeping + canteen + maintenance) can lift wallet share
bear_case: Structurally low-margin labour-arbitrage services - a ~6% EBITDA target for 2030 caps the earnings-power ceiling
Currently around breakeven; ROE negative - no demonstrated profitable-scale model yet
~126x P/E already discounts the demerger and STEAG story
Revenue growth without margin is not a 10x/100x driver; peers (Quess, SIS, Updater) trade as low-multiple, low-margin compounders
Brand-new listing, no VP scrutiny, integration/execution risk on acquired businesses
verdict_headline: Growing but structurally thin-margin services rollup at ~126x earnings - fails the quality gate and the thesis math
verdict_reasoning: Source is a trusted-x-watch snippet mention (@a_basumallick, 2026-08-17): 'On the STEAG acquisition - TAM in thermal capacity, and margins for that segment ~2x the company's current margins.' Stated plainly: a snippet, not a conviction call; no conviction floor.
No live-theme match. Facilities / business-services is not an active_themes.json theme.

Fails the quality gate on its own terms: ~5% ROCE, negative ROE, sub-6% EBITDA-margin ambition for 2030, ~126x P/E. Revenue growth of 15-20% off a thin-margin base does not produce a 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years outcome.
No red flag (low debt, going concern intact, losses are transition-year) - conviction Low, not a HIGH CAUTION.
